create_integer_variable: create an integer variable with optional lower and upper bounds for the ILP model
create_binary_variable: create a binary variable for use in the integer linear programming solver model
set_objective_function: set the objective function to maximize or minimize a given equation in the ILP model
add_constraint: add a linear constraint with an optional name to the ILP solver model
solve_ilp: solve the integer linear programming problem and return variable values or raise on infeasibility
